interface.signature: def ReFormatString(S: str, K: int) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in S is either alphanumeric or a dash.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c == '-' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All alphabetic characters in the output are uppercase, and dashes are preserved only between groups.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value.split('-')) == len([g for g in S.split('-') if g])
postconditions.description: The number of groups in the output matches the number of non-empty groups in the original string (ignoring empty groups from leading/trailing dashes).

postconditions.expression: all(len(g) == K for g in return_value.split('-')[1:])
postconditions.description: All groups except the first have exactly K characters.
The first group has at least 1 and at most K characters.
The output is formed by converting all lowercase letters to uppercase and inserting dashes only between groups.
